text:
Maya: Quick design review — rules builder reorder feels jumpy when dragging long stacks. Dropzone snap is disorienting, and keyboard reordering with Space/Enter doesn't announce new position. Screenshot attached. Sam: Seeing it too. Repro steps: drag rule A (pos 8) near rule B (pos 2) and it leaps to the top. Suspect virtualization + snap slab math. Elena: Agree. Two asks: reduce snap threshold, and add an SR announcement like 'Moved rule to position 3 of 12' after a keyboard reorder. Kevin: Also noticed the validation toast flashes 'Rule order saved' then flips to an error (400) during the live sim — could be debounce/ack timing. @Jia can you check how the UI treats 202 vs 200 from sim API? Jia: @Kevin Yup — sim returns 202 then 200. Front-end currently treats non-200 as failure. I'll change it to treat 202 as in-progress and surface a small spinner state. ETA: tomorrow for a PR. Maya: :ear: a11y-bot flagged contrast on the drag-handle icon (low ratio) and small hit target. We should bump the clickable area and ensure a visible focus ring. a11y-bot: Automated scan: drag-handle.svg contrast ratio 2.7:1 vs background; target <18px icons need 4.5:1. Recommend larger icon or darker stroke + role='button' + aria-label. Sam: Copy nit: the error 'Invalid rule precedence' is too vague. Suggest 'Rule order invalid — circular dependency in rule "Rate Limit A"' or a compact 'Resolve dependencies to save order'. Elena: For keyboard flow propose: visible Move Up / Move Down buttons on hover+focus (and bound to keybindings). Show a small tooltip with the shortcut (eg. Ctrl+Alt+↑ / Ctrl+Alt+↓). Kevin: UX question: should the preview simulation live-update while dragging (lots of churn) or pause until drop? Maya: I'd prefer pause while dragging with a light overlay 'Preview paused while editing' and resume after drop. Less noise and fewer spurious errors. Jia: I'll prototype: debounce ack handling, treat 202 as processing, and emit a 'position-change' ARIA event after the reorder settles. Example live region snippet I plan to add: ```html
Moved rule to position 3 of 12
``` Sam: :thumbsup: Could we also soften the movement with a subtle fade instead of abrupt snap? Keeps orientation. Maya: Thanks all. Next steps: @Jia push fix branch for API ack and SR announcements; @Elena update the error copy options; @Sam mock the micro-interaction (fade + lower snap threshold). Sync Friday 11:00am PT if we need a quick design pass. Kevin: I'll follow up on the toast debounce and add a regression test for the sim-flip. Elena: Adding small accessibility checklist items to the ticket: increase handle hit target to 44px, focus-visible outline, update icon contrast, announce new position, and keyboard-only move controls. Maya: Cool — tagging this thread into the design ticket. Thanks everyone! :seedling:
